newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac mandated for BTR Nylex MTN.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac mandated for BTR Nylex MTN.

text.p: Westpac Banking Group said it has been mandated to arrange a A$500 million domestic medium term note programme for BTR Nylex.
It will also jointly lead the first issue off the programme with Commonwealth Bank of Australia.
The ANZ Bank and National Australia Bank have also been appointed dealers to the programme and would also participate in the first issue.

BTR Nylex would utilise the programme to diversify its funding base and initially the proceeds would be used to refinance part of its bank debt. The company currently has debt facilities and a domestic commerical paper programme.

"It is significant BTR Nylex represents the strongest rated industrial corporate so far to access the Australian corporate securities market since the market's emergence as a viable alternative funding source," said Westpac's Global Head of
BTR Nylex carried a long term debt rating of A plus and it was expected that notes issued under the programme would carry the same rating.
The issuer is a wholly-owned subsidiary of BTR Plc, a major manufacturing engineering group based in London.
